company.name: Carefull
company.shortDescription: Organize and protect your loved one's finances.
company.description:
An estimated 45 million of us are financial caregivers — adult children responsible for the financial well-being of our aging parents. We pay bills, haggle with utilities, plan for their future, and pay for things they need — all while managing our own financial and family life.

Carefull is a new company building digital services for financial caregivers. Our goal is to make it easier to support our aging parents and to help families make better financial decisions together.

Visit us at getcarefull.com to learn more.

productsAndServices.description: A subscription-based financial safety service that monitors money, credit, and identity for fraud, scams, suspicious activity, and everyday financial mistakes.
productsAndServices.name: Carefull Financial Safety Platform

productsAndServices.description: A platform for banks and credit unions to provide customers with fraud detection, financial safety monitoring, caregiver support, and family-engagement capabilities without direct core integration.
productsAndServices.name: Carefull for Financial Institutions

productsAndServices.description: A digital organization and handoff tool that gathers financial accounts, bills, documents, passwords, contacts, notes, and instructions for authorized family members or estate recipients.
productsAndServices.name: LegacyKit

productsAndServices.description: A scam-screening tool that analyzes suspicious texts, emails, and letters and explains the risk level and recommended next steps.
productsAndServices.name: ScamCheck

productsAndServices.description: A financial-safety service for wealth-management firms that protects clients from scams, elder fraud, identity risks, and money mistakes while supporting family engagement and wealth-transfer relationships.
productsAndServices.name: Carefull for Wealth Advisors

productsAndServices.description: Educational guidance and human assistance that help users understand financial alerts, scams, identity risks, and caregiving issues and decide what to do next.
productsAndServices.name: Financial Safety Content and Live Support

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $5,890,482 to $131,428,232, a 22.31x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 67 (-5 over 90 days) and market heat at 59 (+3).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include EverSafe, True Link Financial, Zelle.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
